H2811I.name: Hashabiah
H2811I.desc: Levite living at the time of United Monarchy
H2811I.brief: A musician in the temple, son of Jeduthun.
H2811I.short: Hashabiah was a musician in the temple, one of the sons of Jeduthun.

H2811J.name: Hashabiah
H2811J.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2811J.brief: A Levitical officer during the reign of David.
H2811J.short: Hashabiah was a Levitical officer appointed by King David to serve in trans-Jordan.

H2811K.name: Hashabiah
H2811K.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2811K.brief: Leader of the Levites during the reign of David.
H2811K.short: Hashabiah was the leader of the Levites during King David's reign.

H2811G.name: Hashabiah
H2811G.desc: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2811G.brief: A Merarite Levite, son of Amaziah.
H2811G.short: Hashabiah, a Merarite Levite, was the son of Amaziah.

H2811H.name: Hashabiah
H2811H.desc: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
H2811H.brief: A Levite who lived in Jerusalem after the exile.
H2811H.short: Hashabiah was a Levite who lived in Jerusalem after the Babylonian exile.

H2811L.name: Hashabiah
H2811L.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2811L.brief: A Levite leader during King Josiah's reign.
H2811L.short: Hashabiah was a Levite leader who contributed to Josiah's Passover celebration.

H2811M.name: Hashabiah
H2811M.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H2811M.brief: A Levite who returned from Babylonian exile.
H2811M.short: Hashabiah was a Levite who returned from Babylonian exile and served in various roles.

H2811O.name: Hashabiah
H2811O.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H2811O.short: Hashabiah was a Levite supervisor in Jerusalem after the exile.

H2811P.name: Hashabiah
H2811P.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H2811P.brief: A priest during the time of Nehemiah.
H2811P.short: Hashabiah was a priest who served during the time of Nehemiah.

H2811N.name: Hashabiah
H2811N.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H2811N.brief: A Levite who repaired part of Jerusalem's wall.
H2811N.short: Hashabiah was a Levite who repaired a section of Jerusalem's wall.

H2812.name: Hashabnah
H2812.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H2812.brief: One who sealed the covenant with Nehemiah.
H2812.short: Hashabnah was one of the individuals who sealed the covenant with Nehemiah.

H2813G.name: Hashabneiah
H2813G.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H2813G.short: Hashabneiah repaired a section of Jerusalem's wall near his house.

H2813H.name: Hashabneiah
H2813H.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H2813H.brief: A Levite who led the people in prayer.
H2813H.short: Hashabneiah was a Levite who led the people in prayer during a public ceremony.

H2806.name: Hashbaddanah
H2806.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H2806.brief: A man who stood with Ezra during the reading of the Law.
H2806.short: Hashbaddanah was one of the men who stood with Ezra during the public reading of the Law.

H2807.name: Hashubah
H2807.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2807.brief: A descendant of King Jeconiah (Jehoiachin) of Judah.
H2807.short: Hashubah was a descendant of King Jeconiah (Jehoiachin) of Judah.

H2828G.name: Hashum
H2828G.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H2828G.brief: Ancestor of exiles who returned to Jerusalem.
H2828G.short: Hashum was an ancestor of exiles who returned to Jerusalem from Babylon.

H2828I.name: Hashum
H2828I.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H2828I.brief: One who sealed the covenant with Nehemiah.
H2828I.short: Hashum was one of the individuals who sealed the covenant with Nehemiah.

H2828H.name: Hashum
H2828H.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H2828H.brief: A man who stood with Ezra during the reading of the Law.
H2828H.short: Hashum was one of the men who stood with Ezra during the public reading of the Law.

H2815G.name: Hasshub
H2815G.desc: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
H2815G.brief: A Levite who lived in Jerusalem after the exile.
H2815G.short: Hasshub was a Levite who lived in Jerusalem after the Babylonian exile.

H2815J.name: Hasshub
H2815J.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H2815J.brief: One who sealed the covenant with Nehemiah.
H2815J.short: Hasshub was one of the individuals who sealed the covenant with Nehemiah.

H2815H.name: Hasshub
H2815H.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H2815H.brief: Son of Pahath-moab, a repairer of Jerusalem's wall.
H2815H.short: Hasshub, son of Pahath-moab, repaired a section of Jerusalem's wall.

H2815I.name: Hasshub
H2815I.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H2815I.brief: A repairer of Jerusalem's wall opposite his house.
H2815I.short: Hasshub repaired a section of Jerusalem's wall opposite his house.

H2817.name: Hasupha
H2817.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H2817.brief: Ancestor of temple servants who returned from exile.
H2817.short: Hasupha was an ancestor of temple servants who returned to Jerusalem from Babylonian exile.

H2867.name: Hathath
H2867.brief: Son of Othniel, from the tribe of Judah.
H2867.short: Hathath was a son of Othniel, the son of Kenaz, from the tribe of Judah.

H2845.name: Heth
H2845.desc: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
H2845.brief: Son of Canaan and ancestor of the Hittites.
H2845.short: Heth was a son of Canaan and the ancestor of the Hittites, a prominent people group in the ancient Near East.

H2843.name: Hushathites
H2843.brief: A clan or family known for their warriors.
H2843.short: The Hushathites were a clan or family that produced several of David's mighty warriors, including Sibbecai and Mebunnai.

H2884.name: Tabbaoth
H2884.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H2884.brief: Family of temple servants who returned from exile
H2884.short: The Tabbaoth were a family of temple servants who returned to Judah from Babylonian exile.

H2870B.name: Tabeal
H2870B.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2870B.brief: Man whom Syria and Ephraim wanted to make king of Judah
H2870B.short: Tabeal was the man Syria and Ephraim conspired to make king of Judah in place of Ahaz.

H2870A.name: Tabeel
H2870A.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H2870A.brief: Persian official involved in accusing the Jews to Artaxerxes
H2870A.short: Tabeel was a Persian official who joined in writing an accusation against the Jews to Artaxerxes.

H2886.name: Tabrimmon
H2886.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2886.brief: Father of Ben-hadad I, king of Syria
H2886.short: Tabrimmon was the father of Ben-hadad I, the king of Syria who was an ally of Asa king of Judah.

H2875.name: Tebah
H2875.desc: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
H2875.short: Tebah was a son of Abraham's brother Nahor and his concubine Reumah.

H2882.name: Tebaliah
H2882.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2882.short: Tebaliah was a Levite gatekeeper, the third son of Hosah.

H2899.name: Tobadonijah
H2899.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2899.brief: Levite sent by Jehoshaphat to teach the Law
H2899.short: Tobadonijah was a Levite sent by King Jehoshaphat to teach the Book of the Law in the cities of Judah.

H2800.name: Harosheth-hagoyim
H2800.short: Harosheth-hagoyim was a Canaanite city that served as the base for Sisera, the commander of King Jabin's army (<ref="Judg 4:2">Judg 4:2</ref>).

H2832.name: Hashmonah
H2832.brief: A desert campsite during Israel's journey from Egypt.
H2832.short: Hashmonah was one of the places where the Israelites camped during their wilderness wanderings after leaving Egypt.

H2802.name: Hereth
H2802.brief: Forest where David hid from Saul
H2802.short: The forest of Hereth was where David sought refuge when fleeing from King Saul (<ref="1Sa.22.5">1Sa.22.5</ref>).

H2809.name: Heshbon
H2809.brief: Amorite city conquered by Moses, allotted to Reuben
H2809.short: Heshbon, an Amorite city conquered by Moses (<ref="Num.21.25-30">Num.21.25-30</ref>), was allotted to Reuben (<ref="Num.32.37; Josh 13:17">Num.32.37; Josh 13:17</ref>) but later given to the Levites (<ref="Josh 21:39">Josh 21:39</ref>); it was a significant city in the region (<ref="Isa.15.4; 16:8-9; Jer.48.2, 34, 45; 49:3">Isa.15.4; 16:8-9; Jer.48.2, 34, 45; 49:3</ref>).

H2829.name: Heshmon
H2829.brief: A town in the southland of Judah.
H2829.short: Heshmon was a town allotted to the tribe of Judah in the Negev region.

H2855.name: Hethlon
H2855.brief: Place on the northern border of Israel
H2855.short: Hethlon was a place on the northern border of Israel, mentioned in Ezekiel's vision of the restored land (<ref="Ezk.47.15; 48:1">Ezk.47.15; 48:1</ref>).

H2888.name: Tabbath
H2888.brief: Place near where Midianites fled from Gideon
H2888.short: Tabbath, a place near the Jordan River where the Midianites fled after being defeated by Gideon (<ref="Judg. 7:22">Judg. 7:22</ref>).

H2880.name: Tibhath
H2880.brief: City from which David took bronze for the Temple
H2880.short: Tibhath, a city from which David took a large amount of bronze, used in the construction of the Temple (<ref="1Chr. 18:8">1Chr. 18:8</ref>).

H2897.name: Tob
H2897.brief: Region where Jephthah fled and recruited mercenaries
H2897.short: Tob (or Ish-tob), a region east of the Jordan River where Jephthah fled and later recruited mercenaries to fight the Ammonites (<ref="Judg. 11:3, 5; 2Sam. 10:6, 8">Judg. 11:3, 5; 2Sam. 10:6, 8</ref>).

H2887.name: Tebeth
H2887.brief: The tenth month of the Jewish calendar
H2887.short: Tebeth is the tenth month of the Jewish calendar, mentioned in <ref="Esther 2:16">Esther 2:16</ref> as the month in which Esther was taken to King Ahasuerus.
